post_title: What total revenue will Applied Materials report for Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended October 2026)?

question.title: What total revenue will Applied Materials report for Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended October 2026)?
question.description:
Applied Materials (Nasdaq: AMAT) is the largest US maker of wafer fabrication equipment, and its fiscal year ends in late October. Its fiscal Q4 2026 quarter ran to roughly late October 2026.

On August 13, 2026, Applied reported record fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $9,115 million (up 15% sequentially and 25% year over year) and guided fiscal Q4 2026 total revenue to $10,250 million, plus or minus $500 million — roughly 51% growth versus the ~$6.79 billion reported in fiscal Q4 2025 — with non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.02 plus or minus $0.20 (https://ir.appliedmaterials.com/news-releases/news-release-details/applied-materials-announces-third-quarter-2026-results). On October 22, 2026 the company confirmed it will report Q4 and full-year fiscal 2026 results and hold its earnings call on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. ET (https://ir.appliedmaterials.com/news-releases/news-release-details/applied-materials-report-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026-results). As of late October 2026, sell-side consensus sat near $10.30 billion of revenue and $4.06 of adjusted EPS, marginally above the company's own midpoint (https://www.vantagemarkets.com/market-analysis/why-applied-materials-stock-fell-amat-analysis-october-26-2026).

The backdrop is unusually volatile. At its October 13, 2026 investor day Applied raised long-term ambitions — targeting more than 2 percentage points of wafer fab equipment share gain from calendar 2025 to 2030 and a ~54% non-GAAP gross margin target — but declined to give a specific WFE spending forecast; the stock fell sharply over the following two weeks, including a 7% drop after peer Lam Research's October 21 outlook, which guided December-quarter revenue to $8.6 billion plus or minus $400 million and pegged 2026 WFE spending in the mid-$150 billion range (https://www.tikr.com/blog/applied-materials-sinks-7-on-lams-outlook-a-bit-higher-wasnt-enough). Meanwhile AI-infrastructure sentiment cracked: Alphabet fell 12.6% on October 29, 2026 after reporting negative free cash flow, and Amazon disclosed negative trailing-twelve-month free cash flow. Applied's demand is concentrated in leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM and advanced packaging capacity, where it says AI demand is driving multi-year growth.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the total revenue figure (in millions of US dollars) reported in Applied Materials' fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 earnings press release, which is expected to be published on the company's investor relations news page at https://ir.appliedmaterials.com/news-releases on November 12, 2026 (anticipated title: "Applied Materials Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results"). The answer is the "Net revenue" line for the three months then ended in that release's consolidated condensed statement of operations (the line corresponding to the "total revenue" figure the company guides to); for example, if the release reports net revenue of $10,345 million, the question resolves as 10,345. If the release has not been published by November 13, 2026, the question resolves once it is published, using that same figure. If Applied Materials discloses this figure only in an accompanying filing (e.g., the related Form 8-K) and not in the press release, that disclosed figure is used.
question.fine_print: The figure as originally reported for the quarter governs; later restatements or reclassifications do not change the resolution. If Applied Materials never discloses a total revenue figure for the quarter, the question is annulled.
